provenance: Maintainer-authored synthetic Taskloom operations corpus. Relevance labels test retrieval regressions, not model truth or competitor superiority.

documents.title: Recovery policy
documents.text: Interrupted non-idempotent writes require reconciliation. Confirm the original operation's external outcome before deciding how to continue. Do not silently repeat the write.

documents.title: Approval contract
documents.text: The operator approves the exact tool name and arguments. Changing the payload invalidates the recorded decision. A pending ticket alone never grants execution.

documents.title: Generation spending
documents.text: Reserve the worst allowed model cost durably before dispatch. Settle known usage after a response. Keep the reservation when the charge is unknown.

documents.title: Embedding spending
documents.text: A query vector request uses a separate service ledger. Generation limits do not include this service. Failed requests may still incur a charge.

documents.title: Index lifecycle
documents.text: Build source vectors explicitly. A changed corpus fingerprint or model identity invalidates the saved artifact before a query is dispatched. No background rebuild occurs.

documents.title: Citation checking
documents.text: A reference must use a retrieved chunk identifier and an exact quotation from its body. Matching words do not establish whether the cited passage supports the claim.

documents.title: Tenant isolation
documents.text: Authenticated host context determines the tenant and project. Model output and source documents cannot choose ownership or create a new grant.

documents.title: 长任务恢复操作
documents.text: 先核对外部系统是否已完成写入，再记录观察到的结果。不可直接再次执行状态未知的操作。

metadata.tags: 断点恢复 人工核验

documents.title: Worker scheduling
documents.text: The scheduler assigns a queued task to an available process. Losing its lease stops new dispatch. Ownership alone does not guarantee exactly one external side effect.

documents.title: Weekly review notes
documents.text: The team discussed office seating, lunch choices and the next community meeting. These notes contain no operational recovery instructions.

documents.title: Cache configuration
documents.text: Answer identity includes settings that can change returned content. A transport timeout is an operational limit rather than an answer transformation.

documents.title: Operational logging
documents.text: Log event type, outcome and elapsed time. Avoid exporting prompts and credentials by default. External telemetry destinations require explicit host configuration.
